authority.authorization: D023_MARKET_PROGRAM_AUTHORIZED (2026-08-06T15:51:29Z), four user amendments cited verbatim in MARKET_PROGRAM_CONTRACT.md section 0.1

reserved_terms.arbitrage: May be used ONLY for class TRUE_CROSS_BOOK_ARBITRAGE. Any other use is a Severity A vocabulary breach.

classes.definition: A set of wagers across two or more venues, simultaneously executable at witnessed prices, whose combined return is locked positive in every settlement outcome after applying each venue's own settlement rules (push handling, void/DNP rules, dead-heat, listed-player rules). Nothing else may use the word arbitrage.
classes.mechanism: Venues reprice asynchronously and hold mutually inconsistent prices long enough for all legs to be struck.
classes.falsified_by: Same-poll cross-book combinations (family F3, same-poll quotes only) never positive after settlement-rule alignment; or paper-positive combinations that never satisfy simultaneity or persist >= 1 poll interval. Persistence denominated in poll-grid units only; no executability claim without EXECUTION_FEASIBLE.

classes.definition: Line pairs where both wagers can win simultaneously (middles) or related markets within/across books are mutually inconsistent beyond combined vig (dislocations). Positive expectation is probabilistic, never locked. Not arbitrage.
classes.mechanism: Asynchronous line moves leave straddleable gaps; correlated markets are repriced by independent processes.
classes.falsified_by: F4/F7 endpoints null: middle-hit frequency consistent with no informational content; gap distributions explained by vig and discretization.

classes.definition: A venue's quote provably lags an information event or other venues' repricing, leaving a window in which the pre-event price is still offered post-event.
classes.mechanism: Heterogeneous, finite reaction latencies across books to injury/news/lineup events.
classes.falsified_by: Interval-censored reaction analysis (F1/F2, TRUSTED links only) returning INDISTINGUISHABLE_AT_GRID or showing no post-event persistence of PRE-window prices.
classes.constraints: Every claim in this class is a reaction-time claim carrying the full amendment-4 field set. Never supportable by the T2 final-state archive.

classes.definition: The fundamental system's frozen, pre-commence, hashed projection diverges from market-implied value, and the divergence predicts realized outcomes better than the no-vig market.
classes.mechanism: The market misprices fundamentals the frozen model captures.
classes.falsified_by: Residual (F8-style, frozen projection published before commence) shows no predictive content for realized outcomes; calibration no better than the no-vig market at matched cutoffs.

classes.definition: Third-party (vendor/competitor) projections, archived at disciplined cutoffs, carry predictive content beyond the market and/or beyond our own model at matched rungs.
classes.mechanism: Specific vendors incorporate information (lineups, minutes, usage) faster or better than books reprice.
classes.falsified_by: Matched-cutoff benchmarks (same capture_rung AND same ladder_run_id; rungs never mixed) show no incremental accuracy over market-implied or incumbent comparators.

classes.definition: Exploitable regularities in quote dynamics themselves - suspension/reopening displacement, book-specific update rhythm, overround pumping around events - requiring no fundamental opinion about the game.
classes.mechanism: Mechanical/operational behavior of venue pricing engines and risk desks.
classes.falsified_by: F6/F7 preregistered endpoints null; patterns fail to persist in the next registration window.

four_system_separation.rule: None of the four systems substitutes for another. No output of one system is ever accepted as evidence belonging to another. Each substitution is a Severity A breach.

systems.name: fundamental
systems.owns: Player/possession models (frozen possession-lane incumbents and any future market-lane fundamental model); precomputed scenario tables (M13-style repricing states).
systems.interface_exposed: Frozen, hashed, rung-tagged projections with publication timestamp strictly before commence; per-scenario fair-value deltas.

systems.name: market_reaction
systems.owns: Capture (ladder + burst), event-to-quote linkage, reaction/consensus/coherence analysis (families F1-F10).
systems.interface_exposed: TRUSTED linkage records; interval-censored reaction distributions with the full amendment-4 field set; witnessed quote series with tier labels; consensus states at matched polls.

systems.name: execution
systems.owns: Venue registry (M26), order router and shadow execution (M27), usable-edge transform, fill/latency/fee realism (M21/M23).
systems.interface_exposed: Per-venue feasibility rows with citations and last-verified dates; usable_edge = model_edge - fees - expected_slippage - latency_penalty - uncertainty_buffer; shadow audit records.

systems.name: decision_portfolio
systems.owns: Staking, exposure caps, correlation/duplicate control, mode requests (never grants).
systems.interface_exposed: Orders/alerts within the execution mode in force; complete per-opportunity audit records; mode-transition requests routed to USER_REQUIRED gates.

substitution_prohibitions: A fundamental-model edge is never evidence of executability and never evidence the market reacts slowly.
A market-reaction signal never rescues or retunes a fundamental model; the possession incumbent is frozen and P2B section-8 model identity stays closed to this lane.
Execution feasibility never upgrades an evidence label; a tradable venue does not make a signal true.
The decision system generates no evidence, confers no labels, and cannot grant its own mode transitions.

rules: Labels are strictly ordered and reported individually as the set currently held; they are never collapsed into a single success label (no WORKS, no VALIDATED, no aggregate score).
No label is skippable: promotion to a label requires every lower label currently held with its evidentiary record existing independently.
UNDERPOWERED and INDISTINGUISHABLE_AT_GRID are publishable outcomes at any rung.
Reporting a higher label without the per-label records beneath it is a Severity A methodology breach.
Losing any lower label automatically revokes all higher labels.

labels.definition: A named mechanism from the opportunity taxonomy is demonstrated in TRUSTED T0 data via a preregistered family endpoint, surviving the measurement grid.
promotion_requires: Amendment-4 fields on any timing component
Registered estimator from the approved interval-censored set

labels.definition: The signal predicts subsequent line movement, and at this rung that is ALL it is evidence of. Explicitly not evidence of profit; may never be cited as value.
promotion_requires: Out-of-registration-window prediction of quote movement at grid-respecting horizons

labels.definition: The signal systematically beats the WITNESSED close (the CLOSE window, T0 only; never the T2 archive, which has no close).
promotion_requires: Witnessed pregame closes across multiple registration windows

labels.definition: Backtested P&L positive under executable definitions only: prices witnessed at or before decision time, per-venue settlement rules applied, no in-play leakage, degradation-tested.
promotion_requires: Multi-season where the capture record permits
Not driven by extreme wins (influence diagnostics)

labels.definition: A venue path exists in the M26 registry on which the wager class is legally and technically executable in the operating jurisdiction, with fees, limits, latency, and order types characterized.
promotion_requires: M26 registry row with citations and last-verified dates, not self-certified by the platform
Degradation grid applied on the venue's measured latency profile

labels.definition: A SHADOW-mode prospective record, on data captured entirely after the registration froze, meets preregistered performance gates.
promotion_requires: Shadow audit records per the M23 schema
Gates fixed before the window opened

labels.definition: All six lower labels held simultaneously, hard risk controls verified, and the mode transition granted through its USER_REQUIRED gate. Never self-granted by the graph; auto-revoked if any lower label is lost.

rules: A claim about market state at time T requires a capture record whose first-seen (witnessed) timestamp is at or before T, of tier T0 (or T1 under the tier rules).
State asserted at T persists only until the next successful poll; between polls it is interval-censored, never interpolated.
Reconstructed or final-state data is never presented as point-in-time.
Any row with snapshot_utc >= commence_time is excluded from every pregame series at series construction, including every archive use touching the extension files.
Records failing linkage or tier rules are retained with reason codes and excluded; no imputation, no midpointing, no borrowing from correlated books, no narrowing an interval by assumption.

timestamp_tiers.T0: WITNESSED - our process wrote the row at observation. Admissible for timing claims within the uncertainty calculus bounds.
timestamp_tiers.T1: THIRD_PARTY_CONTEMPORANEOUS - vendor-recorded, retrieved later, unwitnessed. Admissible only with an explicit vendor-latency term and an explicit vendor-asserted-unwitnessed label; never the sole basis for an executability claim. Amendment-1 Odds API historical rows enter as T1 at best; coverage verification never upgrades witness.
timestamp_tiers.T2: RETROSPECTIVE_HARVEST - permanently CUTOFF_UNPROVEN for timing. Never admissible for timing claims; bounded non-timing uses only per final_state_archive_ruling.

point_in_time_integrity.tier_inheritance: A derived quantity inherits the weakest tier of any input.

final_state_archive_ruling.source: EVENT_LINKAGE_AND_METHODOLOGY.md Section C, ratified unchanged as the M00 contract ruling per D023 amendment 2
final_state_archive_ruling.object: data/drive_masters/master_odds.csv (20,004 rows, 813 games, event dates 2022-05-21 to 2025-07-03) plus, where noted, the two extension files (406 games, 2025-2026). Tier T2. Permanently CUTOFF_UNPROVEN for timing per D016/P2B.
final_state_archive_ruling.ruling_shape: The archive is neither worthless nor a timing record: a cross-sectional census with an unverified timing label. Any market-lane artifact touching the archive must cite the use class and reproduce that class's caveat text verbatim. A use not enumerated here is prohibited until this contract is amended.
final_state_archive_ruling.caveat_hash_algorithm: sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of caveat_text exactly as given (single line, single spaces at former wrap points)

permitted_uses.name: Book / market / season coverage census
permitted_uses.caveat_text: Coverage figures derive from a retrospective single-snapshot harvest (T2). They describe what the vendor could return in July 2026 about past games, not what was observable at any pregame instant. Presence in this census is not evidence a price was available, firm, or executable at any particular time.

permitted_uses.name: Vig structure and no-vig calibration against realized outcomes, unknown-time
permitted_uses.caveat_text: Calibration is of a snapshot whose capture time is vendor-asserted and unwitnessed (P2B: CUTOFF_UNPROVEN). Results characterize an unknown-time pregame price level and must not be read as closing-line calibration, opening-line calibration, or calibration at T−64 minutes. No CLV, timing, or line-movement inference may be built on this result.

permitted_uses.name: Settlement-rule and identifier inventory
permitted_uses.caveat_text: Identifier and settlement conventions are as of the 2026-07-30 harvest and may not reflect conventions in force during the seasons the rows describe.

permitted_uses.name: Coarse cross-season price-level context (descriptive display and sanity-checking only; never a feature, never a benchmark)
permitted_uses.caveat_text: Season-level price distributions from a T2 harvest describe one unknown-time snapshot per game. Cross-season comparisons may confound market drift with harvest-selection effects; the 2022 season's 75.3% coverage has an undocumented selection rule (P2B §10.3).

permitted_uses.name: Schema fixtures and test corpora (timestamps synthetic in any fixture testing timing logic)
permitted_uses.caveat_text: Fixture data only. Timing fields are synthetic or T2 and carry no evidentiary weight.

permitted_uses.name: Prior elicitation and power analysis for prospective designs
permitted_uses.caveat_text: Priors elicited from a T2 harvest inform design only. They are superseded by the first adequately-powered T0 measurement and are never combined with T0 data in a single likelihood as if exchangeable.

prohibited_uses: Any timing, latency, lead-lag, reaction, or sequencing claim of any kind
Any CLV or closing-line-value computation (the snapshot is not a close and there is no open)
Any open-vs-close movement (exactly one snapshot exists; F10 is structurally impossible on this archive)
Any executability, liquidity, or this-price-was-gettable claim
Use as a feature or benchmark in any predictive model in either lane (the possession-lane exclusion in P2B stands)
Treating odds_snapshot_timestamp as witnessed for any purpose
final_state_archive_ruling.extension_file_rule: The extension files carry 232 + 338 in-play rows (P2B section 7): every M00 use touching the extensions filters snapshot < commence first, including the census.
final_state_archive_ruling.enforcement_hook: M00-class artifacts carry a machine-readable header (m00_use_class, caveat_hash). A missing or mismatched caveat hash fails review; a T2 field reaching a timing claim is a Severity A methodology breach.
subordination_rulings: COMPETITOR_ARCHIVE_DESIGN.md section 4 item 1 OVERRULED IN PART: no CLV-style quantity may be derived from the T2 archive (C.2 prohibits CLV without exception); realized-outcome labels come from game results, not the archive.

COMPETITOR_ARCHIVE_DESIGN.md section 4 item 2 NOT ENUMERATED: using the archive as a benchmark comparator for competitor projections is prohibited until this contract is amended (M00-U4 is never-a-benchmark). Market-implied comparators draw from the new T0 capture pipeline only.
COMPETITOR_ARCHIVE_DESIGN.md section 4 item 3 maps to M00-U1 and is permitted with the U1 caveat verbatim.

timestamp_uncertainty_discipline.rule: Every future reaction-time claim carries explicit timestamp-uncertainty and vendor-latency terms. A reaction-time figure missing either term is a defect, not a result. A claim that cannot carry both terms is reported UNSUPPORTABLE, never stated without them.
mandatory_claim_fields: vendor_latency_bound (value and source per vendor, or UNBOUNDED)
n_trusted and n_excluded with reason-code distribution
timestamp_uncertainty_discipline.sharpness_prohibition: No point estimate finer than the measurement grid G = delta_event + delta_quote + L_max(all vendors) + 2*epsilon_max. Comparative claims below the combined grid resolve to INDISTINGUISHABLE_AT_GRID. Summary statistics of interval-censored data are intervals or named-model estimates, never bare numbers.
timestamp_uncertainty_discipline.vendor_asserted_channel: Vendor-asserted stamps live only in the VENDOR_ASSERTED advisory channel, reported alongside witnessed bounds; advisory numbers never enter a headline, a gate, a preregistered endpoint, or a decision; the two channels are never averaged.

market_snapshot_table.vendor_ts_semantics_rule: Enum book_last_change / vendor_ingest_time / unknown_unverified; defaults to unknown_unverified until vendor documentation or support confirms which.
market_snapshot_table.append_only: A correction is a new row with a new snapshot_id and prev_snapshot_ref pointing at what it corrects; never an UPDATE.

competitor_projection_archive.comparison_rule: Benchmarks compare only rows sharing capture_rung AND ladder_run_id; rungs are never mixed or averaged across.
competitor_projection_archive.propagation_rule: Every benchmark output propagates contributing provider_update_ts_confidence values, non-empty capture_latency_notes, and license_basis values; a result that drops them is non-compliant and may not be presented as a claim.

taints.CLOCK_UNBOUNDED: A capture run without a clock-skew measurement taints its rows CLOCK_UNBOUNDED.
taints.UNBOUNDED_VENDOR: A vendor without a sourced latency bound is UNBOUNDED and inherits inadmissibility for fine-grained statements.

execution_mode_ladder.transition_rule: Modes are mutually exclusive; transitions are one-way gates, never automatic, and none is self-grantable by the graph.

modes.meaning: Generate the exact order that would have been placed, with full audit record; send nothing.
modes.note: Default and starting mode for every strategy.

modes.meaning: Order generated; a single human confirmation or nothing happens.
modes.gate: USER_REQUIRED. The only mode ever contemplated for licensed NY books; the entry mode for exchange testing with real funds.

modes.meaning: API order placement without per-order approval.
modes.gate: Requires ALL of: written platform authorization for algorithmic entry on our account class; jurisdiction clearance in writing; passed sandbox tests; prospective SHADOW performance meeting preregistered gates; verified hard risk controls; explicit financial USER_REQUIRED authorization. None self-grantable.

venue_policy.exchanges: ProphetX / BettorEdge: sandbox and shadow research tracks only while the NY legal conflict is unresolved in writing.
venue_policy.kalshi: Excluded from production planning during its active NY dispute.
venue_policy.licensed_ny_books: Alert-plus-manual-confirm ONLY. Automating their sites, scraping, or reverse-engineering private endpoints is prohibited by their terms and by this program.
venue_policy.verification: All venue claims are unverified web assertions until independently cited in the M26 venue automation registry with last-verified dates; nothing is self-certified by a platform's own claim.
venue_policy.user_only_actions: Account creation, KYC, deposits, and letters to venues are USER actions exclusively.

profitability_standards: Executable definitions only: P&L computed from prices witnessed (T0) at or before decision time, at venues where the wager class existed, with each venue's settlement rules applied; no in-play rows, no reconstructed prices, no best-price-anywhere unless every book quoted at the same poll.

Survives degradation: latency test ladder (100ms/500ms/1s/5s/30s exchange track; 15s-5m per the M21 delay grid), stated stake limits, explicit slippage and fee models. A strategy profitable only at zero latency holds LINE_MOVEMENT_PREDICTIVE_ONLY at best.
Multi-season where the witnessed capture record permits; otherwise labeled window-limited with no multi-season generalization.
Not driven by extreme wins: leave-out-top-N and per-cluster influence diagnostics mandatory; profit that vanishes when top wins are removed is not HISTORICALLY_PROFITABLE.
Capacity reported: every profitability claim states the estimated stake/capital at which the edge persists, or states CAPACITY_UNKNOWN explicitly.
user_required_boundary: purchases (API tier upgrades, subscriptions, data licenses, any spend)
accounts (creation, KYC, deposits, withdrawals, sandbox setup)
credentials (obtaining, holding, or entering any credential or key beyond already-provisioned capture keys)
wagers and orders (any non-SHADOW order on any venue; every CONFIRM click)
staking changes (bankroll size, staking plan, exposure-cap changes)
deployment (any execution-mode transition, and any re-entry after a kill)
legal and risk acceptance (scraping or licensing risk, ToS interpretation, license_basis resolutions, letters to venues, jurisdiction judgments)

hypothesis_families.status: ADOPTED as the frozen hypothesis universe from EVENT_LINKAGE_AND_METHODOLOGY.md section D.1; preregistration per D.2, multiplicity budget per D.3, standing constraints per D.4.

families.name: Open / close (structurally impossible on the T2 archive)

amendment_procedure: This contract is amended only by a ledgered decision citing user authorization, never by a node's own reading of convenience. Stretching the final-state-archive enumeration, coining a new success label, or blending evidence-ladder labels is a Severity A breach.
